title: Document CPython >=3.11.3 floor: asyncio.Lock cancelled-after-grant wedge
description: pyproject requires-python '>=3.11' but a task cancelled at the exact moment asyncio.Lock.acquire is granted can leave the lock wedged (no owner, _locked=True) on CPython 3.11.0-3.11.2 (gh-90155, fixed in 3.11.3/3.12.0). send()/drain_tx_queue() would hang forever on affected interpreters. Window is microscopic and the project venv is 3.11.15; on patched interpreters the lock self-heals and no queue state exists to corrupt. Fix: bump requires-python to >=3.11.3 or document the interpreter floor caveat. Found by robustness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-9qpz.
